paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for three different methods. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), with a linear scale, ranging from 2.5 to 12.5, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU score, also with a linear scale, ranging from 24 to 31, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot compares three lines: Inconsistency-CE (blue circles, dashed line), Consistency-Bi + sampling (orange triangles, dashed line), and Consistency-Bi + beam (green squares, dashed line). The blue line starts at around 24.2 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and increases to approximately 30.2 BLEU at an AL of 12.5, with a notable upward trend. The orange line begins at around 28.5 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and rises to about 30.7 BLEU at an AL of 12.5. The green line starts at a similar point to the orange line and reaches around 31 BLEU at an AL of 12.5, showing a consistent increase across the x-axis range.
